bio.text: Kamela Smith joined the 153rd Delaware General Assembly in 2025 as the representative for the 15th District.
Smith is originally from Philadelphia and moved to Delaware more than two decades ago.
Smith earned an undergraduate degree from the University of Pittsburgh and a master's in education counseling from Wilmington University, and works at a health system.
Smith is a board member of the Delaware Healthy Mother and Infant Consortium and a board of trustee member of the Kalmar Nyckel Foundation.
